scenario: how many people are in the family
english_title: Recognising and Responding to How Many People Are in the Family
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: family & relationships — how many people are in the family
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to how many people are in the family; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Daniel how many people live in his house.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Daniel nhà anh có bao nhiêu người.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Daniel, how many people live in your house?
turns.vietnamese: Daniel này, nhà anh có bao nhiêu người sống ở đó?

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: There are five people in my house.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Năm người à. Nghe vui nhỉ.

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.english: Yes, it is a busy house.
turns.vietnamese: Vâng, nhà tôi lúc nào cũng nhộn nhịp.
